speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome. The constellation of a continuous heart murmur (suggestive of PDA), bluish non-blanching macules (petechiae), cataracts, and sensorineural hearing loss represents the classic triad of this condition.
